title: Trucker's UFO sighting and missing time, from Texas to Nevada government land
place_text: Left I-20 near El Paso, Texas; ended up on government property in Nevada, USA

tellings.quote: I thought I was in Texas, you know. No, you're in Nevada. [laughter]

plain: A former truck driver who gives only his first name, Michael, says that sometime after 1977 he saw an unidentified flying object while driving on the I-20 highway near El Paso, Texas, and then lost track of time. He says that when he came to, he thought he was still in Texas, but he was told he was on government land in Nevada. He tells it on Jesse Michels's podcast as a possible abduction, a stretch of missing hours he can't account for.
